taiwan_aviation.headline: 總統府啟動2026無人機競賽 排除紅色供應鏈產品
taiwan_aviation.summary: 總統府於2026年7月28日宣布啟動「總統盃2026無人機競賽」，以民主同盟及非紅供應鏈為主題。活動由經濟部、教育部及國科會共同辦理各項賽事，並由國科會、工研院與中科院建立審查機制，凡涉及紅色供應鏈之器材或產品均不具參賽資格。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan Presidential Office Launches 2026 Drone Competition Excluding Red Supply Chain
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan's Presidential Office announced the launch of the Presidential Cup 2026 Drone Competition on July 28, 2026, focusing on the themes of democratic alliance and non-red supply chains. The competition will feature events organized by the Ministry of Economic Affairs, the Ministry of Education, and the National Science and Technology Council. Equipment or products linked to the red supply chain will be ineligible to participate. A verification mechanism involving three-stage reviews will be established by the National Science and Technology Council, the Industrial Technology Research Institute, and the National Chung-Shan Institute of Science and Technology to enforce compliance.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 熊本強震擾亂台日航班 華航、星宇轉降福岡 虎航兩班延至翌日
taiwan_aviation.summary: 日本熊本縣7月28日發生規模7.1強震，熊本機場關閉跑道檢查，華航CI194與星宇JX316轉降福岡；台灣虎航IT794及IT767延至翌日。華航並公布熊本航線退改票安排，另將免費載運賑災物資至8月底。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Kumamoto Earthquake Disrupts Taiwan Flights as China Airlines and Starlux Divert to Fukuoka
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: A magnitude 7.1 earthquake in Kumamoto on July 28 prompted a runway inspection at Kumamoto Airport. China Airlines flight CI194 and Starlux flight JX316 diverted to Fukuoka, while Tigerair Taiwan flights IT794 and IT767 were postponed until the following day. China Airlines also announced ticket flexibility and free transport of relief supplies through the end of August.

international_aviation.headline: 波音第二季營收246億美元 交付171架民航機
international_aviation.summary: 波音公布2026年第二季營收246億美元，GAAP每股虧損0.67美元，反映171架商業飛機交付量增加。737-7與737-10認證試飛已完成，預計2026年取得認證、2027年首次交付。777X獲FAA批准展開認證試飛，同樣預計2027年首次交付。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing Reports Q2 Revenue of $24.6 Billion, 171 Commercial Deliveries
international_aviation.summary_en: Boeing recorded second quarter revenue of $24.6 billion with a GAAP loss per share of $0.67, reflecting 171 commercial aircraft deliveries. Certification flight testing for the 737-7 and 737-10 has been completed, with certification expected in 2026 and first delivery in 2027. The 777X received FAA approval to begin certification flight testing, with first delivery also expected in 2027.

sources.name: Boeing — Boeing Reports Second Quarter Results
